date.description: Without a line: the day it left. A line gives its own date.

fee.description: The fee the provider reports, in the paying currency, part of what was paid: it posts to the bank charges account (bank.charges_account).

from_line_id.description: The paying account's line: money out.

from_money_account_id.description: Without the paying line: the account it left.

paid.description: Without the paying line: what left, as the provider reports it.

received.description: Without the receiving line: what arrives, as the provider reports it.

to_line_id.description: The receiving account's line: money in.

to_money_account_id.description: Without the receiving line: the account it reaches.
